Added d.splitPending. mitose() now parks instead of stranding: when cells.length+2 > MAX_CELLS it sets split=false + splitPending=true so the mature cell resumes normal life (keeps feeding, no longer excluded/immortal). processSplits re-engages a pending cell the moment a slot frees (guards room, then splits). growCell no longer instantly re-sets split on a parked adult. Restored nucleus as a second small instanced mesh (old-style, not unified-bake): nucleusGeo unit sphere + emissive teal nucleusMat in materials.js; sim.nucleusMesh InstancedMesh(MAX_CELLS) built/zeroed in buildWorld, torn down in reset/dispose; cells.js renderNuclei() writes per-cell ellipsoid scale (0.62*radius x heading, WIDTH*0.5 transverse) using d.index slot; removeCell zeroes the nucleus slot on death; render() calls it. Bodies keep depthWrite on (opaque nucleus pass shows through 0.9 body). Headless: 60 sim-s stable, reset ok, no NaN. NOTE: needs an eyeball pass - if the core is too faint through the 0.9 body, raise nucleusMat.emissiveIntensity or drop bodyMat.opacity slightly.

Root cause: bodyMat.depthWrite was forced FALSE for the entire mitosis fade window (activeFades toggling, ~36 sim-s per division). With depth write off, transparent body instances are not depth-sorted, so during a dolly/zoom a farther cell can be drawn OVER a nearer one - the nearer body appears to vanish transiently. Fix: depthWrite stays true always; removed all bodyMat.depthWrite toggling + activeFades; fading parent now fades purely via per-instance opacity, and onBeforeCompile discards fragments with diffuseColor.a<0.01 so a fully-faded parent cannot occlude. Verified: instrumented headless zoom/dolly sweep (camera dist 16->3.9, incl. inside shell) never zeroes a non-hidden body matrix; forced-mitosis fade runs opacity transitions with depthWrite constant true, no NaN. Caveat to eyeball: a mid-fade parent still writes depth (occludes cells behind its small silhouette); if objectionable, next step is a dedicated non-depth-writing ghost mesh (noted).

Implemented starvation death. New registry param STARVE_TIME (Survival group, 0=off default, 0-300s, live in Tuner). Cells track d.lastMeal (set at spawn + on every eat via feedCell); updateStarvation() per frame marks a normal (non-mito/splitting/split) cell dying when sim.simTime-lastMeal >= STARVE_TIME, then ramps per-instance body opacity + tailGrow down over STARVE_FADE 1.5s and sets dead=true (existing removeCell cleanup; nucleus hidden while dying). Eating cancels dying (feedCell restores opacity/tailGrow). Daughters get lastMeal reset at mitosis finalize so the ~MITO_TIME non-feeding division window can't kill them. DepthWrite unaffected (cell-8gp fix). Headless: (A) 0=off no deaths; (B) no-food starve-out to 0 cells w/ pools cleaned, no NaN; (C) starving cell recovers if it eats before fade ends. Working with cell-p6k: split-parked adults feed and can starve, freeing cap slots.

Chemotaxis now steers via the tail: chemotaxis sets d.steer (STEER_GAIN, def 0.5), updateTailState integrates (steer + headingRate) into tailLag -> bend, stored as d.tailBend; advance adds headingRate += TAIL_TURN*d.tailBend*dt then ANG_DRAG damps.
